    1304                                                 function automatic bit is_power_of_two(input int value);
    1305            1                    ***0***             return (value > 0) && ((value & (value - 1)) == 0);
    1306                                                 endfunction
    1307                                             
    1308                                             `ifndef SYNTHESIS
    1309                                                 initial begin
    1310                                                     if (CSR_DATA_WIDTH != 32) begin
    1311                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: CSR_DATA_WIDTH must be 32");
    1312                                                     end
    1313                                             
    1314                                                     if (STRB_WIDTH != 4) begin
    1315                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: STRB_WIDTH must be 4");
    1316                                                     end
    1317                                             
    1318                                                     if (CSR_ADDR_WIDTH < 12) begin
    1319                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: CSR_ADDR_WIDTH must be at least 12");
    1320                                                     end
    1321                                             
    1322                                                     if (ADDR_WIDTH > 32) begin
    1323                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: ADDR_WIDTH above 32 is not supported by 32-bit CSR registers");
    1324                                                     end
    1325                                             
    1326                                                     if (P16_RECIPE_QUEUE_DEPTH != 4) begin
    1327                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: P16_RECIPE_QUEUE_DEPTH must be 4 for the P16B CSR map");
    1328                                                     end
    1329                                             
    1330                                                     if (GEMM_DIM_WIDTH > 32) begin
    1331                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: GEMM_DIM_WIDTH above 32 is not supported by 32-bit CSR registers");
    1332                                                     end
    1333                                             
    1334                                                     if (!is_power_of_two(STRB_WIDTH)) begin
    1335                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: STRB_WIDTH must be a power of two");
    1336                                                     end
    1337                                                 end
    1338                                             `endif

    1340                                                 // ------------------------------------------------------------
    1341                                                 // Byte-strobe helpers
    1342                                                 // ------------------------------------------------------------
    1343                                                 function automatic logic [31:0] strobe_to_mask(
    1344                                                     input logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] strb
    1345                                                 );
    1346                                                     logic [31:0] mask;
    1347                                                     int unsigned i;
    1348                                                 begin
    1349            1                     144128             mask = 32'h0000_0000;
    1350                                             
    1351            1                     144128             for (i = 0; i < STRB_WIDTH; i++) begin
    1351            2                     576512     
    1352                                                         if (strb[i]) begin
    1353            1                     191520                     mask[(i * 8) +: 8] = 8'hFF;
    1354                                                         end
    1355                                                     end
    1356                                             
    1357            1                     144128             return mask;
    1358                                                 end
    1359                                                 endfunction
    1360                                             
    1361                                                 function automatic logic [31:0] apply_wstrb32(
    1362                                                     input logic [31:0]           old_value,
    1363                                                     input logic [31:0]           new_value,
    1364                                                     input logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] strb
    1365                                                 );
    1366                                                     logic [31:0] mask;
    1367                                                 begin
    1368            1                      11465             mask = strobe_to_mask(strb);
    1369            1                      11465             return (old_value & ~mask) | (new_value & mask);
    1370                                                 end
    1371                                                 endfunction

    1374                                                 function automatic bit recipe_slot_addr_is_valid(
    1375                                                     input logic [CSR_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr
    1376                                                 );
    1377                                                     int unsigned slot_idx;
    1378                                                     logic [CSR_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rel_addr;
    1379                                                     logic [6:0] slot_offset;
    1380                                                 begin
    1381                                                     if (addr < CSR_RECIPE_SLOT_BASE_ADDR) begin
    1382            1                          8                 return 1'b0;
    1383                                                     end
    1384                                             
    1385            1                       2549             rel_addr    = addr - CSR_RECIPE_SLOT_BASE_ADDR;
    1386            1                       2549             slot_idx    = rel_addr >> 7;
    1387            1                       2549             slot_offset = rel_addr[6:0];
    1388                                             
    1389                                                     if (slot_idx >= P16_RECIPE_QUEUE_DEPTH) begin
    1390            1                          8                 return 1'b0;
    1391                                                     end
    1392                                             
    1393                                                     if (slot_offset[1:0] != 2'b00) begin
    1394            1                        104                 return 1'b0;
    1395                                                     end
    1396                                             
    1397            1                       2437             return 1'b1;
    1398                                                 end

    444                                                  function automatic logic [DIM_WIDTH-1:0] calc_ktile_len(
    445                                                      input logic [DIM_WIDTH-1:0] base_k
    446                                                  );
    447                                                      int unsigned remaining;
    448                                                      int unsigned tile_limit;
    449                                                  begin
    450             1                        230             tile_limit = GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE;
    451                                              
    452                                                      if (int'(dim_k) > int'(base_k)) begin
    453             1                        230                 remaining = int'(dim_k) - int'(base_k);
    454                                                      end
    455                                                      else begin
    456             1                    ***0***                 remaining = 0;
    457                                                      end
    458                                              
    459                                                      if (remaining > tile_limit) begin
    460             1                         94                 calc_ktile_len = DIM_WIDTH'(tile_limit);
    461                                                      end
    462                                                      else begin
    463             1                        136                 calc_ktile_len = DIM_WIDTH'(remaining);
    464                                                      end
    465                                                  end
    466                                                  endfunction

    474             1                        152             tile_limit = GEMM_N_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE;
    475

    478                                                      end

    481                                                      end
    482                                              
    483                                                      if (remaining > tile_limit) begin
    484             1                         72                 calc_ntile_len = DIM_WIDTH'(tile_limit);

    492                                                  function automatic logic [DIM_WIDTH-1:0] calc_mtile_len(
    493                                                      input logic [DIM_WIDTH-1:0] base_m
    494                                                  );
    495                                                      int unsigned remaining;
    496                                                      int unsigned tile_limit;
    497                                                  begin
    498             1                         54             tile_limit = GEMM_M_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE;
    499                                              
    500                                                      if (int'(dim_m) > int'(base_m)) begin
    501             1                         54                 remaining = int'(dim_m) - int'(base_m);
    502                                                      end
    503                                                      else begin
    504             1                    ***0***                 remaining = 0;
    505                                                      end
    506                                              
    507                                                      if (remaining > tile_limit) begin
    508             1                         39                 calc_mtile_len = DIM_WIDTH'(tile_limit);
    509                                                      end
    510                                                      else begin
    511             1                         15                 calc_mtile_len = DIM_WIDTH'(remaining);
    512                                                      end
    513                                                  end
    514                                                  endfunction
    515                                              
    516             1                        640         always_comb begin
    517             1                        640             b_cache_dim_supported =
    518                                                          (dim_k != '0) &&
    519                                                          (dim_n != '0) &&
    520                                                          (int'(dim_k) <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_K) &&
    521                                                          (int'(dim_n) <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_N);
    522                                              
    523             1                        640             b_cache_active_calc =
    524                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_B_CACHE && b_cache_dim_supported;
    525                                              
    526                                                      // First P5 policy:
    527                                                      // - packed B-cache preload is optional and default-off
    528                                                      // - packed preload only supports int8 B elements
    529                                                      // - packed preload only activates when base_addr_b is 4-byte aligned
    530                                                      // - unaligned B bases automatically fall back to the scalar P4 preload path
    531             1                        640             packed_bcache_preload_calc =
    532                                                          b_cache_active_calc &&
    533                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_PACKED_BCACHE_PRELOAD &&
    534                                                          (B_BYTES == 1) &&
    535                                                          (base_addr_b[1:0] == 2'b00);
    536                                              
    537                                                      // First P6 policy:
    538                                                      // - A-row cache is optional and default-off
    539                                                      // - A-row cache requires B-cache for the first implementation
    540                                                      // - A-row cache only supports scalar int8 A preload in P6C
    541                                                      // - unsupported dimensions automatically fall back to the P5 path
    542             1                        640             a_row_cache_dim_supported =
    543                                                          (dim_k != '0) &&
    544                                                          (int'(dim_k) <= GEMM_A_ROW_CACHE_MAX_K);
    545                                              
    546             1                        640             a_row_cache_active_calc =
    547                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_A_ROW_CACHE &&
    548                                                          b_cache_active_calc &&
    549                                                          a_row_cache_dim_supported &&
    550                                                          (A_BYTES == 1);
    551                                              
    552                                                      // First P7 policy:
    553                                                      // - packed A-row preload is optional and default-off
    554                                                      // - packed A-row preload requires A-row cache to be active
    555                                                      // - packed A-row preload only supports int8 A elements
    556                                                      // - packed A-row preload requires base_addr_a to be 4-byte aligned
    557                                                      // - packed A-row preload requires dim_k to be a multiple of 4
    558                                                      // - unsupported cases automatically fall back to the P6 scalar A-row preload path
    559             1                        640             packed_a_row_preload_calc =
    560                                                          a_row_cache_active_calc &&
    561                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_PACKED_A_ROW_PRELOAD &&
    562                                                          (A_BYTES == 1) &&
    563                                                          (base_addr_a[1:0] == 2'b00) &&
    564                                                          (dim_k[1:0] == 2'b00);
    565                                              
    566                                                      // P10D K-tiling policy:
    567                                                      // - K-tiling is default-off and only activates when K exceeds the
    568                                                      //   effective cache tile capacity.
    569                                                      // - The first tiled path is cache-backed and row-accumulator based.
    570                                                      // - Packed preloads may still be enabled for non-tiled P9/P10C cases,
    571                                                      //   but the tiled path uses scalar tile preload for robust
    572                                                      //   tail/alignment behavior.
    573             1                        640             k_tiling_dim_supported =
    574                                                          (dim_k != '0) &&
    575                                                          (dim_n != '0) &&
    576                                                          (int'(dim_k) > GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE) &&
    577                                                          (int'(dim_n) <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_N) &&
    578                                                          (GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_K) &&
    579                                                          (GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE <= GEMM_A_ROW_CACHE_MAX_K);
    580                                              
    581             1                        640             k_tiling_active_calc =
    582                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_K_TILING &&
    583                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_B_CACHE &&
    584                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_A_ROW_CACHE &&
    585                                                          (GEMM_MAC_LANES_EFFECTIVE == 4) &&
    586                                                          (A_BYTES == 1) &&
    587                                                          (B_BYTES == 1) &&
    588                                                          k_tiling_dim_supported;
    589                                              
    590                                                      // P11D N-tiling policy:
    591                                                      // - N-tiling is default-off and only activates when N exceeds the
    592                                                      //   effective output-column tile capacity.
    593                                                      // - The first N-tiled path reuses the P10 row-accumulator scheduler.
    594                                                      // - If K also exceeds the effective K tile size, GEMM_ENABLE_K_TILING
    595                                                      //   must be enabled so K is tiled inside each N tile.
    596                                                      // - Packed B/A preloads are intentionally bypassed for tiled jobs.
    597             1                        640             n_tiling_dim_supported =
    598                                                          (dim_k != '0) &&
    599                                                          (dim_n != '0) &&
    600                                                          (int'(dim_n) > GEMM_N_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE) &&
    601                                                          (GEMM_N_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_N) &&
    602                                                          (GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_K) &&
    603                                                          (GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE <= GEMM_A_ROW_CACHE_MAX_K) &&
    604                                                          ((int'(dim_k) <= GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE) || GEMM_ENABLE_K_TILING);
    605                                              
    606             1                        640             n_tiling_active_calc =
    607                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_N_TILING &&
    608                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_B_CACHE &&
    609                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_A_ROW_CACHE &&
    610                                                          (GEMM_MAC_LANES_EFFECTIVE == 4) &&
    611                                                          (A_BYTES == 1) &&
    612                                                          (B_BYTES == 1) &&
    613                                                          n_tiling_dim_supported;
    614                                              
    615                                                      // P12D M-tiling policy:
    616                                                      // - M-tiling is default-off and only activates when M exceeds the
    617                                                      //   effective output-row tile size.
    618                                                      // - The first multi-row path is cache-backed and reuses one B tile
    619                                                      //   across all rows in the active M tile.
    620                                                      // - If K/N exceed their effective tile sizes, the P10/P11 K/N tile
    621                                                      //   schedulers must also be enabled.
    622                                                      // - Packed preloads are intentionally bypassed for tiled jobs.
    623             1                        640             m_tiling_dim_supported =
    624                                                          (dim_m != '0) &&
    625                                                          (dim_k != '0) &&
    626                                                          (dim_n != '0) &&
    627                                                          (int'(dim_m) > GEMM_M_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE) &&
    628                                                          (GEMM_M_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE > 0) &&
    629                                                          (GEMM_N_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_N) &&
    630                                                          (GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_K) &&
    631                                                          (GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE <= GEMM_A_ROW_CACHE_MAX_K) &&
    632                                                          ((int'(dim_n) <= GEMM_N_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE) || GEMM_ENABLE_N_TILING) &&
    633                                                          ((int'(dim_k) <= GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE) || GEMM_ENABLE_K_TILING);
    634                                              
    635             1                        640             m_tiling_active_calc =
    636                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_M_TILING &&
    637                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_B_CACHE &&
    638                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_A_ROW_CACHE &&
    639                                                          (GEMM_MAC_LANES_EFFECTIVE == 4) &&
    640                                                          (A_BYTES == 1) &&
    641                                                          (B_BYTES == 1) &&
    642                                                          m_tiling_dim_supported;
    643                                              
    644             1                        640             tile_schedule_active_calc =
    645                                                          k_tiling_active_calc ||
    646                                                          n_tiling_active_calc ||
    647                                                          m_tiling_active_calc;
    648                                                  end

    651                                                  logic [DIM_WIDTH-1:0]    active_k_limit_calc;

    1                                                // File: rtl/mem/axi_mm_dual_port_bram.sv
    2                                                
    3                                                // ============================================================
    4                                                // Behavioral Multi-clock Dual-port AXI4-MM BRAM
    5                                                //
    6                                                // Introduction
    7                                                // - This is a verification-oriented behavioral memory model
    8                                                // - Two independent AXI4-MM slave ports share one behavioral storage array
    9                                                // - Deterministic, burst-level commit semantics suitable for scoreboards
    10                                               //
    11                                               // Important behavior
    12                                               // - W beats are buffered per burst (writes are NOT applied beat-by-beat into mem_word[])
    13                                               // - A single commit engine (dma_clk domain) commits ONE burst at a time
    14                                               // --  Memory update is atomic per burst (the mem_word[] image changes at burst commit boundary)
    15                                               // --  Commits from Port0/Port1 are serialized by the commit engine
    16                                               // - Apply / commit observation
    17                                               // --  After mem_word[] is updated, apply_if emits the applied beats
    18                                               // --  commit_if emits the committed beats
    19                                               // - Write response timing
    20                                               // --  Port0: B is enqueued only after commit_if emission completes
    21                                               // --  Port1: Last beat ACK back to core_clk is deferred until commit+emit completes; core-side B is then generated
    22                                               //
    23                                               // Clocking / domains
    24                                               // - Port0 runs on dma_clk (AXI slave interface axi0_if)
    25                                               // - Port1 runs on core_clk (AXI slave interface axi1_if)
    26                                               // - Port1 W beats cross into dma_clk via a simple toggle-based request/ack bridge
    27                                               // - The shared storage is a single behavioral array updated only by the dma_clk commit engine
    28                                               //
    29                                               // Verification constraint
    30                                               // - This model is multi-clock (Port0: dma_clk, Port1: core_clk)
    31                                               // - Recommended scoreboard setting: COMMIT_STABLE_DELAY = 30ns
    32                                               // --  This is a testbench constraint to avoid race condition, not a hardware guarantee and not a DUT parameter
    33                                               //
    34                                               // Read path model
    35                                               // - Synchronous read model with 2-cycle latency and per-port read FIFO
    36                                               // - No read forwarding/bypass 
    37                                               // -- Reads observe committed mem_word[] state only
    38                                               //
    39                                               // Assumptions & scope
    40                                               // - Burst types
    41                                               // -- INCR and WRAP are supported
    42                                               // -- FIXED is supported as constant-address accesses
    43                                               // - Responses
    44                                               // -- BRESP/RRESP are OKAY (2'b00) only
    45                                               // - Write ordering
    46                                               // -- W channel is assumed in-order with respect to the active AW (no W reordering across different AW)
    47                                               // - No vendor-specific collision modes are modeled
    48                                               // -- This is not intended to infer a true dual-port BRAM macro
    49                                               //
    50                                               // Endianness / lane mapping
    51                                               // - lane 0 = WDATA[7:0], lowest byte address in word
    52                                               // - WSTRB[0] controls lane 0...N
    53                                               // ============================================================
    54                                               
    55                                               `timescale 1ns/1ps

    1                                                // File: rtl/sequencer/ai_accel_queue_fetch_controller.sv
    2                                                // ============================================================
    3                                                // ai_accel_queue_fetch_controller
    4                                                // ============================================================
    5                                                // P24C single-outstanding command queue fetch controller.
    6                                                //
    7                                                // Scope through P24C:
    8                                                //   - Reads one 64-byte SQ command entry from command memory.
    9                                                //   - Parses and validates the command entry.
    10                                               //   - Presents one accepted/rejected command context to downstream logic.
    11                                               //   - Does not launch P17 descriptor fetch directly yet.
    12                                               //   - Does not update SQ_HEAD / CQ_TAIL directly.
    13                                               //   - Adds queue disabled / invalid config / empty / full / bad pointer handling.
    14                                               //   - Exposes CMD_TIMEOUT_CYCLES from SQ word6 to the wrapper-level
    15                                               //     P24C watchdog. Runtime timeout detection remains in the CSR top
    16                                               //     queue glue because this fetch block does not own the downstream
    17                                               //     descriptor/recipe/completion terminal state.
    18                                               //
    19                                               // Integration intent for P19D/P19E:
    20                                               //   cmd_valid/cmd_ready handshake becomes the boundary into the existing
    21                                               //   descriptor-fetch launch path and completion-writeback allocation path.
    22                                               //
    23                                               // Baseline assumptions:
    24                                               //   - DATA_WIDTH = 64 for the current subsystem baseline.
    25                                               //   - SQ entry size = 64 bytes, 16 logical 32-bit words.
    26                                               //   - CQ entry size = 64 bytes, existing P18 completion record format.
    27                                               //   - One outstanding command context at a time.
    28                                               // ============================================================

    262                                                  function automatic bit is_power_of_two(input int value);
    263             1                    ***0***             return (value > 0) && ((value & (value - 1)) == 0);
    264                                                  endfunction
    265                                              
    266                                                  function automatic bit addr_is_aligned(
    267                                                      input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr
    268                                                  );
    269                                                      if (BYTES_PER_BEAT <= 1) begin
    270                                                          return 1'b1;
    271                                                      end
    272                                                      else begin
    273             1                        774                 return (addr[BEAT_ADDR_LSB-1:0] == '0);
    274                                                      end
    275                                                  endfunction
    276                                              
    277                                                  function automatic bit launch_is_valid(
    278                                                      input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] src_addr,
    279                                                      input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] dst_addr,
    280                                                      input logic [31:0]           beats
    281                                                  );
    282             1                        390             return (beats != 0) &&
    283                                                             addr_is_aligned(src_addr) &&
    284                                                             addr_is_aligned(dst_addr);
    285                                                  endfunction

    269                                                  function automatic bit is_power_of_two(input int value);
    270             1                    ***0***             return (value > 0) && ((value & (value - 1)) == 0);
    271                                                  endfunction
    272                                              
    273                                                  function automatic bit addr_is_aligned(
    274                                                      input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr
    275                                                  );
    276                                                      if (BYTES_PER_BEAT <= 1) begin
    277                                                          return 1'b1;
    278                                                      end
    279                                                      else begin
    280             1                        970                 return (addr[BEAT_ADDR_LSB-1:0] == '0);
    281                                                      end
    282                                                  endfunction
    283                                              
    284                                                  function automatic bit is_valid_operand_sel(input logic sel);
    285             1                        482             return (sel === OPERAND_A) || (sel === OPERAND_B);
    286                                                  endfunction

    288                                                  function automatic bit launch_is_valid(

    290                                                      input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] dst_addr,
    291                                                      input logic [31:0]           beats,
    292                                                      input logic                  operand_sel
    293                                                  );
    294             1                        488             return (beats != 0)              &&
    295                                                             addr_is_aligned(src_addr) &&
    296                                                             addr_is_aligned(dst_addr) &&
    297                                                             is_valid_operand_sel(operand_sel);

    2                                                `ifndef SCRATCHPAD_PORT0_OWNER_MUX_SV
    3                                                `define SCRATCHPAD_PORT0_OWNER_MUX_SV

    5                                                module scratchpad_port0_owner_mux #(
    6                                                    parameter int ADDR_WIDTH   = 32,
    7                                                    parameter int DATA_WIDTH   = 64,
    8                                                    parameter int ID_WIDTH     = 4
    9                                                )(
    10                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------
    11                                                   // Owner select
    12                                                   //
    13                                                   // Legacy naming:
    14                                                   //   select_dma = DMA_LOAD owner select
    15                                                   //
    16                                                   // Owner policy:
    17                                                   //   select_dma       = 0, select_dma_store = 0 -> HOST owns Port0
    18                                                   //   select_dma       = 1, select_dma_store = 0 -> DMA_LOAD owns Port0
    19                                                   //   select_dma       = 0, select_dma_store = 1 -> DMA_STORE owns Port0
    20                                                   //   select_dma       = 1, select_dma_store = 1 -> illegal, Port0 held inactive
    21                                                   //
    22                                                   // Rules:
    23                                                   //   - No arbitration / outstanding tracking is done here.
    24                                                   //   - Owner select must only change when Port0 is idle.
    25                                                   //   - Host traffic must not be issued while DMA load/store owns Port0.
    26                                                   //
    27                                                   // P13 note:
    28                                                   //   DMA_STORE may be used after a C RMW accumulation sequence, but this
    29                                                   //   mux only sees the final store transaction. It does not participate
    30                                                   //   in GEMM partial accumulation.
    31                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------
    32                                                   input  logic select_dma,
    33                                                   input  logic select_dma_store = 1'b0,
    34                                               
    35                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------
    36                                                   // Host-side AXI-MM interface
    37                                                   //   Mux behaves as a slave toward the external host.
    38                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------
    39                                                   axi_mm_if.mp_slave host_axi_if,
    40                                               
    41                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------
    42                                                   // BRAM-side AXI-MM interface
    43                                                   //   Mux behaves as a master toward BRAM Port0.
    44                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------
    45                                                   axi_mm_if.mp_master bram_axi_if,
    46                                               
    47                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------
    48                                                   // DMA load engine scratchpad write-side master
    49                                                   //
    50                                                   // DMA_LOAD:
    51                                                   //   - uses AW/W/B channels
    52                                                   //   - read channel is disabled
    53                                                   //   - intended for A/B preload into scratchpad before GEMM starts
    54                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------
    55                                                   input  logic [ID_WIDTH-1:0]      dma_awid,
    56                                                   input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]    dma_awaddr,
    57                                                   input  logic [7:0]               dma_awlen,
    58                                                   input  logic [2:0]               dma_awsize,
    59                                                   input  logic [1:0]               dma_awburst,
    60                                                   input  logic                     dma_awvalid,

    574                                                      end

    578                                                  // ============================================================
    579                                                  // Accelerator control CDC
    580                                                  //
    581                                                  // External acc_start/config are considered dma_clk-domain.
    582                                                  //
    583                                                  // Flow:
    584                                                  //   dma_clk:
    585                                                  //     - detect acc_start rising edge
    586                                                  //     - capture config bus
    587                                                  //     - toggle start event
    588                                                  //
    589                                                  //   core_clk:
    590                                                  //     - synchronize start toggle
    591                                                  //     - generate one-cycle raw start event
    592                                                  //     - latch captured config into core-domain registers
    593                                                  //     - launch GEMM one core_clk cycle later
    594                                                  //
    595                                                  // Notes:
    596                                                  //   This is a bundled-data style CDC for configuration.
    597                                                  //   The config registers are captured in dma_clk before the
    598                                                  //   start event reaches core_clk. The source config registers
    599                                                  //   must remain stable until the start event is sampled in
    600                                                  //   core_clk. Current software/testbench sequencing satisfies
    601                                                  //   this because config is only changed between GEMM jobs.
    602                                                  //
    603                                                  // Frontend preload rule:
    604                                                  //   GEMM start is accepted only when AXI-Stream preload and
    605                                                  //   Direct Stream preload are both idle. This prevents GEMM from
    606                                                  //   consuming operands before the selected preload path is complete.
    607                                                  // ============================================================
    608                                              
    609                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    610                                                  // dma_clk side: acc_start rising-edge detect
    611                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    612                                                  logic acc_start_dma_q;
    613                                                  logic acc_start_pulse_dma;
    614                                                  logic acc_start_pulse_dma_accepted;
    615                                              
    616             1                       2806         assign acc_start_pulse_dma = acc_start & ~acc_start_dma_q;
    617                                              
    618             1                       2492         assign acc_start_pulse_dma_accepted =
    619                                                      acc_start_pulse_dma &&
    620                                                      !axis_load_busy_i   &&
    621                                                      !ds_load_busy_i;
    622                                              
    623             1                       2229         always_ff @(posedge dma_clk or negedge dma_rst_n) begin
    624                                                      if (!dma_rst_n) begin
    625             1                        308                 acc_start_dma_q <= 1'b0;
    626                                                      end
    627                                                      else begin
    628             1                       1921                 acc_start_dma_q <= acc_start;
    629                                                      end
    630                                                  end
    631                                              
    632                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    633                                                  // dma_clk side: captured GEMM configuration
    634                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    635                                                  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]     base_addr_a_dma_q;
    636                                                  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]     base_addr_b_dma_q;
    637                                                  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]     base_addr_c_dma_q;
    638                                              
    639                                                  logic [GEMM_DIM_WIDTH-1:0] dim_m_dma_q;
    640                                                  logic [GEMM_DIM_WIDTH-1:0] dim_n_dma_q;
    641                                                  logic [GEMM_DIM_WIDTH-1:0] dim_k_dma_q;
    642                                              
    643                                                  logic                      gemm_input_stream_mode_dma_q;
    644                                                  logic                      accumulate_enable_dma_q;
    645                                              
    646                                                  logic                      start_toggle_dma_q;
    647                                              
    648             1                       2526         always_ff @(posedge dma_clk or negedge dma_rst_n) begin
    649                                                      if (!dma_rst_n) begin
    650             1                        308                 base_addr_a_dma_q <= '0;
    651             1                        308                 base_addr_b_dma_q <= '0;
    652             1                        308                 base_addr_c_dma_q <= '0;
    653                                              
    654             1                        308                 dim_m_dma_q       <= '0;
    655             1                        308                 dim_n_dma_q       <= '0;
    656             1                        308                 dim_k_dma_q       <= '0;
    657                                              
    658             1                        308                 gemm_input_stream_mode_dma_q <= 1'b0;
    659             1                        308                 accumulate_enable_dma_q      <= 1'b0;
    660                                              
    661             1                        308                 start_toggle_dma_q <= 1'b0;
    662                                                      end
    663                                                      else if (acc_start_pulse_dma_accepted) begin
    664             1                        589                 base_addr_a_dma_q <= base_addr_a;
    665             1                        589                 base_addr_b_dma_q <= base_addr_b;
    666             1                        589                 base_addr_c_dma_q <= base_addr_c;
    667                                              
    668             1                        589                 dim_m_dma_q       <= dim_m;
    669             1                        589                 dim_n_dma_q       <= dim_n;
    670             1                        589                 dim_k_dma_q       <= dim_k;
    671                                              
    672             1                        589                 gemm_input_stream_mode_dma_q <= gemm_input_stream_mode;
    673             1                        589                 accumulate_enable_dma_q      <= accumulate_enable;
    674                                              
    675             1                        589                 start_toggle_dma_q <= ~start_toggle_dma_q;
    676                                                      end
    677                                                  end
    678                                              
    679                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    680                                                  // core_clk side: start toggle synchronizer
    681                                                  //
    682                                                  // The armed flag prevents a false start pulse after reset when
    683                                                  // the synchronized toggle value initializes to the current
    684                                                  // source-domain toggle value.
    685                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    686                                                  logic start_sync1_q;
    687                                                  logic start_sync2_q;
    688                                                  logic start_sync2_qq;
    689                                                  logic start_sync_armed_q;
    690                                              
    691                                                  logic gemm_start_core_raw;
    692                                                  logic gemm_start_core;
    693                                              
    694             1                       3122         always_ff @(posedge core_clk or negedge core_rst_n or negedge dma_rst_n) begin
    695                                                      if (!core_rst_n || !dma_rst_n) begin
    696             1                        458                 start_sync1_q      <= 1'b0;
    697             1                        458                 start_sync2_q      <= 1'b0;
    698             1                        458                 start_sync2_qq     <= 1'b0;
    699             1                        458                 start_sync_armed_q <= 1'b0;
    700                                                      end
    701                                                      else if (!start_sync_armed_q) begin
    702             1                        154                 start_sync1_q      <= start_toggle_dma_q;
    703             1                        154                 start_sync2_q      <= start_toggle_dma_q;
    704             1                        154                 start_sync2_qq     <= start_toggle_dma_q;
    705             1                        154                 start_sync_armed_q <= 1'b1;
    706                                                      end
    707                                                      else begin
    708             1                       2510                 start_sync1_q      <= start_toggle_dma_q;
    709             1                       2510                 start_sync2_q      <= start_sync1_q;
    710             1                       2510                 start_sync2_qq     <= start_sync2_q;
    711                                                      end
    712                                                  end
    713                                              
    714             1                       1636         assign gemm_start_core_raw = start_sync_armed_q &&
    715                                                                               (start_sync2_q ^ start_sync2_qq);
    716                                              
    717                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    718                                                  // core_clk side: delayed GEMM start pulse
    719                                                  //
    720                                                  // Keep gemm_top.start one core_clk cycle after the synchronized
    721                                                  // start event. This lets the core-domain configuration registers
    722                                                  // below become visible to gemm_top before its start_accept cycle.
    723                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    724             1                       2229         always_ff @(posedge core_clk or negedge core_rst_n) begin
    725                                                      if (!core_rst_n) begin
    726             1                        308                 gemm_start_core <= 1'b0;
    727                                                      end
    728                                                      else begin
    729             1                       1921                 gemm_start_core <= gemm_start_core_raw;
    730                                                      end
    731                                                  end
    732                                              
    733                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    734                                                  // core_clk side: latched GEMM configuration
    735                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    736                                                  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]     base_addr_a_core_q;
    737                                                  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]     base_addr_b_core_q;
    738                                                  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]     base_addr_c_core_q;
    739                                              
    740                                                  logic [GEMM_DIM_WIDTH-1:0] dim_m_core_q;
    741                                                  logic [GEMM_DIM_WIDTH-1:0] dim_n_core_q;
    742                                                  logic [GEMM_DIM_WIDTH-1:0] dim_k_core_q;
    743                                              
    744                                                  logic                      gemm_input_stream_mode_core_q;
    745                                                  logic                      accumulate_enable_core_q;
    746                                              
    747             1                       2044         always_ff @(posedge core_clk or negedge core_rst_n) begin
    748                                                      if (!core_rst_n) begin
    749             1                        308                 base_addr_a_core_q <= '0;
    750             1                        308                 base_addr_b_core_q <= '0;
    751             1                        308                 base_addr_c_core_q <= '0;
    752                                              
    753             1                        308                 dim_m_core_q       <= '0;
    754             1                        308                 dim_n_core_q       <= '0;
    755             1                        308                 dim_k_core_q       <= '0;
    756                                              
    757             1                        308                 gemm_input_stream_mode_core_q <= 1'b0;
    758             1                        308                 accumulate_enable_core_q      <= 1'b0;
    759                                                      end
    760                                                      else if (gemm_start_core_raw) begin
    761             1                        589                 base_addr_a_core_q <= base_addr_a_dma_q;
    762             1                        589                 base_addr_b_core_q <= base_addr_b_dma_q;
    763             1                        589                 base_addr_c_core_q <= base_addr_c_dma_q;
    764                                              
    765             1                        589                 dim_m_core_q       <= dim_m_dma_q;
    766             1                        589                 dim_n_core_q       <= dim_n_dma_q;
    767             1                        589                 dim_k_core_q       <= dim_k_dma_q;
    768                                              
    769             1                        589                 gemm_input_stream_mode_core_q <= gemm_input_stream_mode_dma_q;
    770             1                        589                 accumulate_enable_core_q      <= accumulate_enable_dma_q;
    771                                                      end
    772                                                  end
    773                                              
    774                                                  // ============================================================
    775                                                  // Direct-stream operand region size calculation
    776                                                  //
    777                                                  // Direct Stream mode redirects only A/B reads to the operand buffer.
    778                                                  // The router uses padded A/B byte regions so final stream-beat padding
    779                                                  // remains valid. Reads outside those regions, including C RMW old-C
    780                                                  // reads, stay on the scratchpad path.
    781                                                  // ============================================================
    782                                                  logic [31:0] direct_a_bytes_core;
    783                                                  logic [31:0] direct_b_bytes_core;
    784                                                  logic [31:0] direct_a_region_bytes_core;
    785                                                  logic [31:0] direct_b_region_bytes_core;
    786                                              
    787                                                  function automatic logic [31:0] round_up_to_data_beat(
    788                                                      input logic [31:0] byte_count
    789                                                  );
    790                                                      logic [31:0] beat_bytes;
    791                                                      logic [31:0] rem;
    792                                                  begin
    793             1                       1280             beat_bytes = 32'(DATA_WIDTH / 8);
    794             1                       1280             rem        = byte_count % beat_bytes;
    795                                              
    796                                                      if (byte_count == 0) begin
    797             1                        608                 round_up_to_data_beat = 32'd0;
    798                                                      end
    799                                                      else if (rem == 0) begin
    800             1                        316                 round_up_to_data_beat = byte_count;
    801                                                      end
    802                                                      else begin
    803             1                        356                 round_up_to_data_beat = byte_count + beat_bytes - rem;
    804                                                      end
    805                                                  end
    806                                                  endfunction
    807                                              
    808             1                        640         always_comb begin
    809             1                        640             direct_a_bytes_core =
    810                                                          32'(int'(dim_m_core_q) * int'(dim_k_core_q) * (GEMM_A_WIDTH / 8));
    811                                              
    812             1                        640             direct_b_bytes_core =
    813                                                          32'(int'(dim_k_core_q) * int'(dim_n_core_q) * (GEMM_B_WIDTH / 8));
    814                                              
    815             1                        640             direct_a_region_bytes_core = round_up_to_data_beat(direct_a_bytes_core);
    816             1                        640             direct_b_region_bytes_core = round_up_to_data_beat(direct_b_bytes_core);
    817                                                  end

    842                                              
    843                                                  // ============================================================
    844                                                  // Core-domain accelerator done generation
    845                                                  //
    846                                                  // gemm_top.done means the compute FSM has reached done. The subsystem
    847                                                  // waits for the scratchpad adapter and input router to drain before
    848                                                  // toggling acc_done, so downstream DMA store/readback sees completed C.
    849                                                  // ============================================================
    850                                                  logic                     gemm_done_core_q;
    851                                                  logic                     gemm_done_pulse_core;
    852                                              
    853                                                  logic                     acc_done_pending_core_q;
    854                                                  logic                     acc_done_core_pulse_q;
    855                                                  logic                     acc_done_toggle_core_q;
    856                                              
    857                                                  logic                     acc_busy_core;
    858                                              
    859             1                       2223         always_ff @(posedge core_clk or negedge core_rst_n) begin
    860                                                      if (!core_rst_n) begin
    861             1                        308                 gemm_done_core_q <= 1'b0;
    862                                                      end
    863                                                      else begin
    864             1                       1915                 gemm_done_core_q <= gemm_done_core;
    865                                                      end
    866                                                  end
    867                                              
    868             1                       2061         assign gemm_done_pulse_core = gemm_done_core & ~gemm_done_core_q;
    869                                              
    870             1                     114127         always_ff @(posedge core_clk or negedge core_rst_n) begin
    871                                                      if (!core_rst_n) begin
    872             1                        308                 acc_done_pending_core_q <= 1'b0;
    873             1                        308                 acc_done_core_pulse_q   <= 1'b0;
    874             1                        308                 acc_done_toggle_core_q  <= 1'b0;
    875                                                      end
    876                                                      else begin
    877                                                          // default: pulse only one core_clk cycle
    878             1                     113819                 acc_done_core_pulse_q <= 1'b0;
    879                                              
    880                                                          // latch the fact that GEMM core finished
    881                                                          if (gemm_done_pulse_core) begin
    882             1                        587                     acc_done_pending_core_q <= 1'b1;
    883                                                          end
    884                                              
    885                                                          // once adapter is no longer busy, emit subsystem done pulse
    886                                                          if (acc_done_pending_core_q && !gemm_mem_busy && !gemm_router_busy) begin
    887             1                        587                     acc_done_core_pulse_q   <= 1'b1;
    888             1                        587                     acc_done_pending_core_q <= 1'b0;
    889             1                        587                     acc_done_toggle_core_q  <= ~acc_done_toggle_core_q;
    890                                                          end
    891                                                      end
    892                                                  end
    893                                              
    894             1                     113200         assign acc_busy_core = gemm_busy_core | gemm_mem_busy | gemm_router_busy;
    895                                              
    896                                                  // ============================================================
    897                                                  // Accelerator status CDC back to dma_clk
    898                                                  //
    899                                                  // acc_busy:
    900                                                  //   core_clk level -> dma_clk 2FF synchronizer
    901                                                  //
    902                                                  // acc_done:
    903                                                  //   core_clk pulse -> toggle -> dma_clk pulse
    904                                                  //
    905                                                  // The done armed flag prevents a false done pulse after reset
    906                                                  // when the destination synchronizer initializes to the current
    907                                                  // source-domain toggle value.

    910                                                  logic acc_busy_sync2_dma_q;
    911                                              
    912                                                  logic done_sync1_dma_q;
    913                                                  logic done_sync2_dma_q;
    914                                                  logic done_sync2_dma_qq;
    915                                                  logic done_sync_armed_dma_q;
    916                                              
    917                                                  logic acc_done_dma_pulse;
    918                                              
    919             1                       4140         always_ff @(posedge dma_clk or negedge dma_rst_n or negedge core_rst_n) begin

    921             1                        458                 acc_busy_sync1_dma_q <= 1'b0;

    923                                                      end
    924                                                      else begin

    927                                                      end
    928                                                  end
    929                                              
    930             1                       3114         always_ff @(posedge dma_clk or negedge dma_rst_n or negedge core_rst_n) begin

    932             1                        458                 done_sync1_dma_q      <= 1'b0;

    934             1                        458                 done_sync2_dma_qq     <= 1'b0;
    935             1                        458                 done_sync_armed_dma_q <= 1'b0;
    936                                                      end
    937                                                      else if (!done_sync_armed_dma_q) begin
    938             1                        154                 done_sync1_dma_q      <= acc_done_toggle_core_q;
    939             1                        154                 done_sync2_dma_q      <= acc_done_toggle_core_q;
    940             1                        154                 done_sync2_dma_qq     <= acc_done_toggle_core_q;
    941             1                        154                 done_sync_armed_dma_q <= 1'b1;
    942                                                      end
    943                                                      else begin

    1267            1                        709         assign queue_auto_continue_start_pulse_i = queue_auto_continue_pending_q &&
    1268                                                                                            csr_queue_enable &&
    1269                                                                                            csr_queue_run_until_empty &&
    1270                                                                                            !queue_busy_i &&
    1271                                                                                            (queue_timeout_error_status_q == 32'h0000_0000);
    1272                                             
    1273            1                        491         assign queue_start_pulse_to_controller = (csr_queue_start_pulse ||
    1274                                                                                          queue_auto_continue_start_pulse_i) &&
    1275                                                                                          (queue_timeout_error_status_q == 32'h0000_0000);
    1276                                             
    1277            1                       1002         always_ff @(posedge dma_clk or negedge dma_rst_n) begin
    1278                                                     if (!dma_rst_n) begin
    1279            1                        136                 desc_fetch_external_reject_q        <= 1'b0;
    1280            1                        136                 desc_fetch_external_reject_status_q <= 32'h0000_0000;
    1281                                                     end else begin
    1282                                                         if (csr_desc_fetch_clear_error_pulse) begin
    1283            1                        123                     desc_fetch_external_reject_q        <= 1'b0;
    1284            1                        123                     desc_fetch_external_reject_status_q <= 32'h0000_0000;
    1285                                                         end
    1286                                             
    1287                                                         if (csr_desc_fetch_start_pulse && desc_fetch_start_blocked_i) begin
    1288            1                          2                     desc_fetch_external_reject_q           <= 1'b1;
    1289            1                          2                     desc_fetch_external_reject_status_q[0] <= 1'b1;
    1290                                                         end
    1291                                                     end
    1292                                                 end
    1293                                             
    1294            1                        150         assign desc_fetch_reject_to_csr = desc_fetch_reject_i |
    1295                                                                                   desc_fetch_external_reject_q;
    1296                                             
    1297            1                        150         assign desc_fetch_reject_status_to_csr = desc_fetch_reject_status_i |
    1298                                                                                          desc_fetch_external_reject_status_q;

    1595                                                 // ============================================================
    1596                                                 // P19/P20 command queue fetch controller
    1597                                                 //
    1598                                                 // P19D consumes one accepted SQ command context and launches the
